text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dot: one synthetic substation on one of 5 seeds. Dashed line: fitted equals injected. The offset is the mean heating contribution over winter rows minus the fleet curve's. No pooling is left out: its offsets mostly fall outside these axes.'
